RemediationStrings.Title: The Engramic Baseline isn't installed on this device.
RemediationStrings.Description: IT needs to install the Engramic Baseline so this device can be checked. Contact IT.

RemediationStrings.Title: This device hasn't been checked recently (last check {ActualValue} hours ago).
RemediationStrings.Description: Leave the device switched on and connected for a while so the daily check can run. If this keeps happening, contact IT.

RemediationStrings.Title: This device has {ActualValue} control(s) that automatically fail Cyber Essentials.
RemediationStrings.Description: These are usually missing security updates or out-of-date apps. Install all updates in Settings > Windows Update, update your apps, then restart. Open 'Engramic Baseline' from the Start menu to see what needs fixing, or contact IT.

RemediationStrings.Title: This device has {ActualValue} failing Cyber Essentials control(s).
RemediationStrings.Description: Open 'Engramic Baseline' from the Start menu to see which controls are failing and apply the suggested fixes, or contact IT.

RemediationStrings.Title: This device meets {ActualValue}% of the applicable Cyber Essentials v3.3 controls (needs at least 80%).
RemediationStrings.Description: Some controls still need attention or attestation. Open 'Engramic Baseline' from the Start menu, work through the items marked 'attention' and 'to confirm', then re-run the audit. Contact IT if you need help.
